author: Mike Bishop
releaseNotes: More resilient to iCOMM service outages: longer timeouts, retries, and re-login before token expiry. Status reports 'Update failed' only after 3 consecutive failed polls; logs one warning (with the cause) when failures start and one on recovery. Rejected credentials are reported immediately. Polls now use a random offset; click Save Preferences on the iCOMM device to apply it.
